transcript: Tonight I attended the current Broadway revival of A doll's House starring Jessica Chastain. I don't wanna give too much away, but I will say it was amazing, and the ending left me absolutely shook. The stage in the blocking is very bare and simple, and this did not bother me at all. I was super impressed with all the performances, and the way that Jessica Chastain accesses such emotion with just the sound of her voice, like, it was incredibly effective to me. And I was sitting all the way up in the balcony. Also, about 15 minutes before the end of the show, somebody in the orchestra, I believe, had some sort of medical emergency, and they had to stop the show, have the actors leave the stage and bring up the house lights for a few minutes. But once the person was seen by an EMT and the performance resumed, the actors jumped right back into this, like, super climactic scene. And I was just so impressed by that. Anyway, go see this.
